verses.text: A song for going up to worship. Happy is everyone who respects the LORD, who follows his ways.
You will eat what your hands have worked for. You will be happy, and things will go well for you.
Your wife will be like a fruitful grapevine inside your house. Your children will be like young olive trees around your table.
This is how the man who respects the LORD will be blessed.
May the LORD bless you from Zion. May you see Jerusalem do well all the days of your life.
May you live to see your grandchildren. May there be peace in Israel.
